description:
Enriches or corrects an existing job application's saved posting details: source URL and/or job description. Use this when the user finds the JD later, wants to add the posting link, or wants to correct the saved description.

Do NOT use this for status changes — use update_job_application_status. Do NOT use this for withdraw/reactivate ('not interested') — use toggle_job_application_interest. This tool only touches source_url and job_description.

At least one of source_url or job_description is required. job_description REPLACES the previously saved description — pass the full text, not a diff. Omitting a field leaves it unchanged.

job_description.description: The full job description text. Replaces any previously saved description for this application.

source_url.description: The URL of the job posting.

uuid.description: The UUID of the job application to update. Find it with search_job_applications, find_job_application, or get_recent_applications.

name: update_job_application
